6 May 1992 — Karadžić and Boban meet in Graz, Austria, and agree to divide Bosnia between them. Herzegovina Corps and HVO Southeast Herzegovina observe a ceasefire. Kiseljak pocket forces hold positions. Posavina corridor fighting continues unabated.
